algorithm: Wind-weighted A* on an 8 m terrain-following cruise surface with checked vertical takeoff/landing legs

wind.terrain_adapter: Sample original flat-geometry field at local AGL. Wind not recomputed on terrain-restored geometry. No CFD reference validation.

provenance.station_policy: 100 synthetic ground sites, one per 10x10 domain stratum; exclude water, roads, building/tree columns; not surveyed or licensed landing sites
provenance.geometry_limits: 2.5D column approximation from terrain-restored meshes; cannot represent underpasses or overhangs

limitations: Synthetic station locations, not real landing sites.
Static 3D model wind at 7500 s; no gust/forecast or rotor dynamics.
Routes are optimal only on the constrained 8 m cruise surface with endpoint-averaged wind costs; not arbitrary 3D trajectories.
Collision evidence covers the rasterized 2.5D geometry, not exact mesh, wires or moving objects.
Time is kinematic segment integration, not measured flight performance.
Only selected neighbouring station pairs are precomputed; not all 9900 ordered pairs.
graph: 100 stations strongly connected via 336 directed neighbour routes
validation: All 336 exported routes passed conservative cruise-cell clearance and 0.5 m sampling against 2 m terrain/building/tree columns. No failed paths are displayed.
